title: Forward date and datetime formats in OpenpyxlWriter constructor
answers: Why are date_format and datetime_format ignored in ExcelWriter with openpyxl?
How to ensure OpenpyxlWriter preserves custom date and datetime formats in to_excel?
Why does pandas to_excel ignore date formatting when using engine openpyxl?
body:
Symptom: ExcelWriter with engine="openpyxl" ignores date_format and datetime_format when exporting DataFrames to Excel.
Root cause: pandas/io/excel/_openpyxl.py:OpenpyxlWriter.__init__ did not forward date_format and datetime_format to super().__init__.
Fix pattern: Forward date_format and datetime_format arguments to super().__init__ in ExcelWriter subclass constructors.
Constraints: Applies when subclassing ExcelWriter and delegating date format handling to the base class.
